title: Dink and Wink
style: Novelty alt-pop with bouncy mid-tempo swing, rubbery clap groove, and a didgeridoo drone threaded through the hook; verse stays sparse with dry percussion and spoken-sung cheek, pre-chorus lifts with handclaps and cheeky chant doubles, chorus pops with gang vocals and playful yelps. Quick risers, boomerang synth swells, crisp bright mix with dusty earth tones.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I met you at the net, mate
You said, "nice dink, yeah?"
Then you sliced it past my grin
And laughed as I said, "fair dinkum"

Your serve had me shook
My paddle went flying
You called that one "cheeky"
I called it "too spicy"

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh, you’ve got that grin
And I’m in the spin
One more little touch
Then you’re pulling me in

[Chorus]
Dink and wink, dink and wink
You got me in a pickle, in a blink
Dink and wink, dink and wink
That naughty little lob made me think
Dink and wink, dink and wink
Say "good on ya" then you do it again
Dink and wink, dink and wink
I’m laughing, I’m blushing, I’m done, my friend

[Verse 2]
Boots on the court, sunburned and proud
You said "wanna rally?" way too loud
I chased that drop shot, slipped on my pride
You shrugged like, "mate, that’s part of the ride"

Someone yelled "out!"
But it kissed the line
You raised one brow
And stole my mind

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh, you’ve got that grin
And I’m in the spin
One more little touch
Then you’re pulling me in

[Chorus]
Dink and wink, dink and wink
You got me in a pickle, in a blink
Dink and wink, dink and wink
That naughty little lob made me think
Dink and wink, dink and wink
Say "good on ya" then you do it again
Dink and wink, dink and wink
I’m laughing, I’m blushing, I’m done, my friend

[Bridge]
[Didgeridoo break]
You near the kitchen, I lose my cool
Act all innocent, break every rule
One little smile, I’m off the map
Then you call me back with a paddle tap

[Final Chorus]
Dink and wink, dink and wink
You got me in a pickle, in a blink
Dink and wink, dink and wink
That naughty little lob made me think
Dink and wink, dink and wink
Say "good on ya" then you do it again
Dink and wink, dink and wink
I’m laughing, I’m blushing, I’m done, my friend
